e.r: Overly dense visual clutter with competing elements (multiple photos, icons, doodles, text, patterned background) creates no clear focal point — violates (figure-ground must be clear at a glance) and (framing is editorial choice), making the composition feel chaotic and unprofessional.

The text 'i swear she's an angel' is placed on a low-contrast, semi-transparent beige overlay that blends with the background and lacks sufficient contrast for legibility at a glance — violates figure-ground clarity and undermines the message’s readability.
